The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.

WHY ENGINE INFRA?

Engine Infra  team is responsible for the game-server fleet that simulates live experiences — making it efficient, observable, and reliable on Roblox edge infrastructure and regional cloud capacity, from multiplexing and ARM bursting through telemetry, resource allocation, and edge latency.

You Will:

  • Define Metrics — Own Engine Infra metrics, telemetry logging, and validation for the RCC fleet and edge compute. Establish KPIs for game-server efficiency, reliability, and player experience — including CPU and memory, heartbeat, occupancy and multiplexing efficiency, crash and OOM rates, runtime error codes, and latency quality (e.g. DataPing vs RakPing) that directly affect creators and players.
  • Transform & Visualize Data for Actionable Insights — Access and process raw RCC and engine telemetry, build analytics pipelines, and deliver clear operating views of the fleet. Turn per-instance, per-game, datacenter, and channel signals into dashboards and decision systems that help Engine Infra pack more players onto fewer cores, allocate CPU and memory correctly, and keep multiplexed and large-server processes healthy.
  • Design Experiments & Apply Causal Inference — Lead channel tests, hardware A/Bs, and causal analyses for multiplexing, ARM64 bursting, regional capacity, and edge latency. Measure trade-offs among efficiency, stability, and quality; separate host, container, engine, content, and release effects; and estimate player-experience impact (including latency-sensitive cohorts, not only global averages) so launches ship on evidence.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with Engine Infra, Game Engine, Networking, Matchmaking, Infrastructure, Product, and TPMs, and with teams such as Creator Analytics and Growth, to debug ambiguous production issues and open new capacity and quality opportunities.
  • Shape the Future of Roblox’s Foundation — Influence how Roblox runs live experiences on owned edge and cloud hardware — a more efficient RCC fleet, better regional capacity, lower edge latency, and a platform that stays interactive as we scale toward larger, denser servers.

You Have:

title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Sandbox Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interface level.
  • Sound judgment on tradeoffs: knowing when tighter isolation is worth the cost and when it isn't.
  • A security mindset: you default to least privilege and distrust every input crossing the boundary.

Nice to have

  • Experience across more than one of the three platforms.
  • Kernel, hypervisor, or low-level OS internals work.
  • Fuzzing, exploit development, or red-team experience against isolation boundaries.

The Traffic Proxy Services team powers the front line of Roblox — operating the global edge network and high-performance Layer 7 proxies that handle billions of web and API requests daily while defending the platform against large-scale automated attacks. In this role, you'll help pioneer the next generation of our edge infrastructure: replacing legacy proxy configurations with programmable, memory-safe Rust services running on Kubernetes, and building intelligent, automated defense systems. Working alongside principal engineers and key partners across Security, Reliability, and Platform teams, you'll tackle high-stakes systems challenges where efficiency, scale, and uptime are critical.

You Are: 

  • An experienced systems engineer with 7+ years building and operating backend or infrastructure software, including time owning a tier-0 service in production.
  • Fluent in a systems language. Rust strongly preferred; strong Go experience with the appetite to work in Rust is welcome.
  • Deeply comfortable with networking fundamentals: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, QUIC and the internals of at least one production L7 proxy (HAProxy, Envoy, NGINX, Pingora or similar). Able to troubleshoot a live network problem.
  • Familiar with how the kernel and userspace interact, and comfortable tuning the kernel to optimize for efficiency and reliability.
  • Experienced with high-performance packet processing in and around the kernel — kernel-bypass and kernel-path techniques such as eBPF/XDP.
  • Able to independently design, build, and operate systems on Kubernetes end to end, and to reason about node-level behavior when latency and resource isolation matter.
  • Able to write a design doc that survives review by senior stakeholders across several teams, and to disagree productively when it doesn't.
  • Motivated by problems where the blast radius is real and the feedback loop is immediate.
  • Genuinely curious. You pull on the thread until you understand why a system behaves the way it does, and you would rather learn an unfamiliar layer of the stack than route around it. 

You Will:

  • Design and build high-performance services that sit directly in the request data path, where performance, reliability, and security are of utmost priority.
  • Effectively leverage AI tools to speed up research, development, and troubleshooting while keeping a critical eye
  • Evolve our edge architecture toward something simpler and programmable, migrating policy incrementally with parity testing and exercised rollback.
  • Improve traffic classification and intelligence to detect and mitigate DDoS and abuse traffic.
  • Build feedback loops that automate mitigation and reduce MTTR.
  • Raise the efficiency of the edge 
  • Own your work in production as part of the team's on-call rotation, and raise the reliability bar through design, code review, incident review.
  • Collaborate across Networking, Security, Reliability, and Compute to deliver on Infrastructure and company priorities.
  • Be a gatekeeper for a high code quality bar, architectural designs, and pragmatic vs. long-term approaches.

title: Engineering Director, Storage
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.

As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.

You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.

You will

  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
  • Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
  • Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
  • Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
  • Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
  • Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents

You have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
  • A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
  • Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D asset pipelines, or GPU/client performance. Deep specialization in one area is not required, but meaningful hands-on experience is.
  • Real-time Performance Mindset: Experience diagnosing tradeoffs among CPU/GPU time, memory, loading latency, visual quality, and frame-time stability on constrained platforms such as mobile or console.

descriptionHtml:

As a Software Engineer on Account Security, you will help protect Roblox users, creators, and the broader community from bad actors. We are an outcome oriented team that has the tremendous latitude to make changes across the Roblox technical stack to secure accounts. Past examples of work include work to model post-login suspicion, cryptographically bind user credentials to devices, malware detection, and work to detect and prevent asset laundering that typically is used to monetize ATOs.

You'll join Roblox's Safety organization, whose mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities by detecting, removing, and preventing problematic accounts, content, and behavior, and by keeping accounts secure and free from compromise. The team draws on a broad tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers, experimentation, automation, and AI-powered filters, partnering with product teams to shape the roadmap, build safety products, and measure impact on our community of users and developers.

You Will:

  • Own the design, implementation and landing of features to prevent, detect and mitigate account takeovers.
  • Collaborate cross-organizationally with partner teams in InfoSec, Economy, User, and the broader Roblox Safety org.
  • Help define how goals get accomplished and have real influence over product direction.
  • Instrument and analyze user interaction data (A/B tests, usage metrics) to inform design decisions and maximize product impact.
  • Own implementation end to end across the stack, contributing in GoLang, Python, Typescript and Lua as projects require, using AI tools wherever possible.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering/Computer Science
  • Experience working on user facing applications or services
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as GoLang, Python, C#, and Javascript.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product stakeholders to define requirements and deliver technical solutions.
  • A strong commitment to designing, implementing, and maintaining systems that prioritize user safety, data integrity, and compliance with safety policies.

The App Test team builds the test automation platform that enables Roblox engineers to deliver reliable, high-quality experiences across the Roblox Universal App. Our systems span test frameworks, execution and orchestration, device-farm infrastructure, debugging tools, dashboards, and the supporting infra that power end-to-end testing across mobile, desktop, console, and VR.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the App Test team, you will design, build, and scale tools and  services that power the test automation lifecycle. You will work on foundational systems that enable engineers to author, select, execute, debug, maintain, and triage tests efficiently, while helping evolve our platform toward an AI-native testing experience.

You will have the opportunity to solve complex engineering problems across distributed systems, cross-platform automation, developer tooling, and AI orchestration. Your work will help teams identify regressions earlier, improve release confidence, and deliver software faster without compromising quality.

You will:

  • Build and scale test automation infrastructure: Design, implement, and evolve the frameworks, runners, orchestration services, device-farm integrations, and supporting infrastructure that power reliable end-to-end testing across Roblox's supported platforms
  • Advance the AI-native test lifecycle: Develop intelligent tooling that improves test authoring, selection, execution, maintenance, and failure triage, using AI to reduce manual effort and make testing more accessible and effective
  • Develop test orchestration and intelligence: Build systems that connect test planning, test selection, execution, and failure analysis, enabling more efficient use of test infrastructure and faster feedback to engineers

  • As a Safety Threat Investigator on the Safety Investigations team, you will primarily support Roblox’s Core Investigations capability: the operational backbone for repeatable, high-sensitivity matters that require speed, consistency, evidence discipline, and strong documentation. You will independently manage investigations from intake through resolution and produce clear, defensible work product that supports high-confidence safety decisions.

    You will also identify when a matter requires deeper attribution, network-centric analysis, cross-platform research, proactive threat hunting, or externally meaningful work product, and partner with or escalate to Specialized Investigations as appropriate. At the CL9 level, you will own a defined safety-risk domain or pod-level workstream, improve investigative processes and standards, serve as a subject-matter expert, and mentor other investigators with limited day-to-day oversight.

    Please note: This role may require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. It may also require participation in an on-call rotation during weekends and holidays.

    You Will

    • Own repeatable, high-sensitivity investigations involving serious safety threats, including child exploitation, violent extremism, organized fraud, compromised accounts, coordinated abuse, and other high-risk matters.
    • Apply structured investigative methods, evidence checklists, common templates, and approved data pulls to produce timely and consistent case outcomes.
    • Gather, preserve, analyze, and corroborate evidence while maintaining accurate provenance, confidentiality, and auditability.
    • Define investigative questions, scope, hypotheses, evidence plans, milestones, risk controls, and exit criteria for sensitive or ambiguous matters.
    • Conduct focused account, entity, and timeline linkage as needed, and identify when a case requires deeper attribution, network mapping, or cross-platform investigation.
    • Escalate cases to Specialized Investigations when they develop meaningful attribution complexity, broader network risk, external actionability, or a need for deeper synthesis.
    • Prepare clear case summaries and standardized downstream work product for partners such as Legal, Safety Intelligence, Trust & Safety Operations, Law Enforcement Operations, or NCMEC, as appropriate.
    • Track recurring patterns, operational pain points, and escalation trends, and translate findings into recommendations for Policy, Product, Engineering, Detection, Legal, and Safety Operations.
    • Lead or contribute to durable improvements such as investigation playbooks, evidence standards, intake criteria, triage processes, tooling requirements, and quality-review mechanisms.
    • Represent Safety Investigations with cross-functional stakeholders, explain and defend investigative decisions, navigate disagreement, and maintain alignment on sensitive matters.
    • Mentor investigators, provide constructive feedback on casework, and raise the team’s standards for investigative rigor, documentation, and inclusive collaboration.
    • Maintain strong case hygiene, document decisions and approvals, and ensure investigations are closed with clear outcomes, residual-risk ownership, and follow-up actions.
    • Deliver rigorous, timely, and consistent outcomes on high-sensitivity investigations.
    • Apply sound judgment in triage, lane assignment, escalation, and case closure.
    • Improve the team’s investigative methods, operating processes, templates, and quality standards.
    • Convert case findings into concrete safety improvements and upstream action.
    • Build trust with cross-functional partners and mentor others to strengthen the team’s investigative capability.

    You Have

    • 4+ years conducting sensitive investigations involving severe safety, abuse, fraud, security, threat, or other high-risk matters.
    • Demonstrated ability to independently manage investigations end-to-end, including intake, scoping, evidence development, analysis, findings, recommendations, and follow-through.
    • Experience using SQL and/or Python, large datasets, and open-source intelligence in an investigative context.
    • Strong investigative judgment and the ability to distinguish facts, inferences, allegations, unknowns, assumptions, and analytical conclusions.
    • Experience with attribution, account or entity linkage, network analysis, open-source intelligence, external intelligence, or cross-platform research.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and defensible work product for investigators, leadership, Legal, Product, Engineering, and external-facing stakeholders.
    • Ability to turn ambiguous questions into precise investigation plans and drive complex, multi-week or multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
    • Systems-oriented thinking and the ability to connect individual cases to policy, product, process, detection, legal, reputational, and user-trust considerations.
    • Experience influencing partners and creating alignment in high-stakes or time-sensitive situations.
    • Demonstrated mentorship, informal leadership, or subject-matter expertise that helps other investigators grow.
    • Sound judgment, discretion, curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to evidence-based, fair, and proportionate investigations.

title: Senior Software Engineer- User Behavior
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why User Behavior?

You will build the backend systems that fundamentally shift how Roblox responds to unsafe behavior - from reactive, stateless punishment to a personalized, adaptive system that reflects who a user actually is.

You will own core backend infrastructure for a new capability at Roblox: a low-latency behavioral data layer, a centralized rules-and-inference engine, and a unified intervention-delivery framework that together let us treat users based on their real risk profile instead of a single point total. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

You will:

  • Build the User Behavior Foundation: Design and operate the low-latency, per-user behavioral data layer that powers real-time safety decisions - aggregating signals like violation history, in-game reports, and behavioral patterns into a single queryable source of truth.
  • Own the Consequence Engine: Build and evolve the centralized decision engine that combines deterministic rules with ML risk signals into a single, consistent safety decision  the authoritative system every consequence flows through.
  • Own the Feature Restriction Platform: Build a unified, backend-driven framework for delivering safety interventions that any product team can plug into, replacing today's fragmented, feature-specific implementations.
  • Unify Abuse Reporting: Build the backend that consolidates reporting channels into a single, scalable framework - integrating LLM-based classification, agentic review workflows, and ML models to improve report routing, prioritization, and reporter feedback while meeting global regulatory requirements.
  • Design for trust and auditability: Build serving infrastructure that meets a high bar for explainability and fairness, since these systems directly determine consequences for millions of users.
  • Ship code, not just designs: Own end-to-end delivery - from system design through migration, testing, and production operation.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale, ideally in Go or a comparable statically-typed backend language.
  • Strong experience designing distributed systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), data modeling for high-throughput event ingestion, caching, and low-latency read paths.
  • Experience building and evolving rules engines, workflow/decision systems, or similarly stateful business-logic services.
  • Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines feeding a feature store or similar ingestion layer, and comfort partnering with ML engineers who consume that data.
  • Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, capacity planning, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
  • Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud, risk, or other adversarial domains; experience with feature stores or ML-serving infrastructure; experience building frontend-agnostic, backend-driven UI frameworks (e.g. server-driven intervention/notification rendering).

You are:

  • A Systems Thinker: capable of designing infrastructure that other teams (ML, feature teams, policy) build on top of, not just point solutions.
  • A Pragmatic Builder: scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals and legacy code paths into clean, well-owned services.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: this space is actively being redefined — you'll help set the standard, not just implement one handed to you.
  • A Reliability-Minded Engineer: you treat testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job, not afterthoughts.
  • Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering: dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

Roblox Premium is the subscription product that gives our most engaged users an upgraded experience on the platform.It is one of the biggest growth opportunities in our economy. As Principal Product Manager for Subscriptions and Revenue Growth, you will own the long-term strategy and roadmap for subscriptions: what subscribers get, why they join, why they stay, and how the subscription business compounds over time. You will work across nearly every team at Roblox, and directly with our developer community, to build benefits that only a subscription can deliver. This is a player-coach role for a product leader who wants scope and influence, and who is energized by owning a business outcome end to end.

This role is based in San Mateo, CA (no remote option) and reports to the Sr. Director Product, Economy.

You will:

  • Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for Roblox subscriptions, including the subscriber value proposition, tiering, pricing, and the multi-year vision for where the product goes next.
  • Drive acquisition and retention as a business owner : grow the subscriber base, improve conversion through the funnel, reduce churn, and expand internationally.
  • Define and ship new subscriber benefits that meaningfully upgrade the experience, partnering with teams across the company to bring their surfaces and features into the subscription.
  • Work directly with developers and creators to build developer-led subscription offerings, making it compelling for them to create value that is exclusive to or enhanced for subscribers.
  • Build and run a rigorous growth experimentation program  and hold the bar on statistical and decision-making quality.
  • Own the metrics and business impact of subscriptions, from subscriber penetration and retention cohorts through to bookings, and communicate that story to executive leadership.
  • Set the product standard for the broader team, mentoring other PMs and raising the quality of strategy, writing, and execution across the group.

You have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with deep expertise in consumer subscription and growth products.
  • Experience operating at principal or staff level: setting direction for a large, cross-company initiative and driving it through teams you do not own.
  • Deep growth experimentation expertise, including A/B testing methodology, funnel analysis, cohort and lifecycle measurement, and knowing the limits of what a test can tell you.
  • A technical approach: delving into product, platform, and implementation details, and the ability to engage engineering on scalable, extensible solutions.

As an Engineering Manager for Engine Networking, you will lead and empower a team of engineers who help players experience the game as a nearly synchronous world that streams in seamlessly. Just as the nerves in our bodies coordinate our actions and the bloodstream delivers what every cell needs, the network system coordinates all the computers involved while the asset pipeline delivers the content that brings the experience to life. You will oversee the architecture, execution, and career growth of engineers working across real-time state synchronization and end-to-end asset delivery in your quest to communicate every part of Roblox to every player, as fast as physically possible.

You Have:

  • Managed, led, or mentored engineering teams working on high-performance, low-latency network infrastructure or content-delivery/asset-streaming systems in client/server environments.
  • Experience driving execution and architectural roadmap for complex multithreaded systems that connect millions of concurrent users worldwide and stream large volumes of content to them reliably.
  • Proven track record delivering systems supporting multi-platform deployments - from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients - including the bandwidth, storage, and memory realities each platform imposes.
  • Experience building systems in resource-constrained environments where every CPU cycle and byte counts.
  •  A background in game engine development, game networking, asset pipelines, or content streaming, with deep familiarity in game loop architecture, state synchronization, and how assets are loaded, prioritized, and made available to the running experience. Preferred)
  • Experience with the asset delivery path - CDNs, caching layers and cache eviction, download scheduling and prioritization, prefetching, (de)compression and decoding, and streaming/incremental loading under tight memory budgets. (Preferred)

You Are:

  • An engineering leader with 8+ years of total software engineering experience, including experience managing or leading high-performing systems, networking, or content-delivery engineering teams.
  • Passionate about continuous technical excellence and comfortable guiding technical strategy around low-level Network Stacks, custom protocols, asset streaming and caching architectures, and open-source contributions.
  • Highly proficient in C++ environments with a deep appreciation for systems-level programming and the underlying CPU/memory behavior (smart pointers, templates, custom allocators) - the same fluency that separates a smooth stream from a stall.
  • Knowledgeable in transport-level optimizations, Linux networking, QoS, and Congestion Control Algorithms, and thoughtful about how those interact with asset delivery - download prioritization, bandwidth adaptation, and time-to-first-frame - with the ability to help your team navigate trade-offs down to the millisecond and the byte.

Roblox's Object Store team is building the in-house, multi-tenant object storage platform that underpins every large-object workload at Roblox — assets, media, analytics, backups, and machine learning datasets — at exabyte scale, trillions of objects, and terabytes per second of throughput. We build and run it ourselves on bare metal in our own data centers, replacing cloud object storage with a platform we control end to end — down to the hardware. As a principal engineer on the Object Store team, you will shape the architecture, build and launch the capabilities that keep this platform durable, fast, and efficient at global scale, and set the technical direction for where it goes next. You will report to the Engineering Manager for Storage.

You will:

  • Design and build the object store — S3-compatible gateway, metadata and indexing, data placement and tiering, multi-tenancy and isolation.
  • Own the technical strategy: multi-year architecture, build-vs-buy calls, and the migration off cloud object storage.
  • Evolve the control plane for elastic scaling, autonomous healing, self-service provisioning, and zero-downtime tenant moves.
  • Run the bare-metal fleet at scale — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, rebalancing, failure domains, hardware and capacity planning.
  • Profile and optimize critical data paths; drive down tail latency and cost per byte.
  • Establish engineering best practices — design reviews, benchmarks, failure drills, post-incident retrospectives — targeting 4+ 9s.
  • Automate everything: testing, CI/CD, rollout safety, observability, autoscaling.
  • Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with security, analytics, and product teams.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering or a relevant field
  • Deep experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage — object stores, blob stores, or distributed file systems — at petabyte scale or beyond.
  • Hands-on experience running an object storage platform in production: data placement and rebalancing, erasure coding, cluster tuning, and upgrades at scale. Depth operating these systems matters more here than contributing to their internals.
  • Strong skills in C++, Go, or Rust.
  • Deep understanding of durability and replication — erasure coding, geo-replication, consistency trade-offs, blast-radius containment.
  • Proven success shipping high-throughput, low-latency services on bare-metal, on-prem fleets with strong observability.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into a clear roadmap and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Passion for automation, rigorous testing, and data-driven decisions.
  • Bonus: upstream contributions to open-source storage projects; S3 API compatibility at scale, NVMe/HDD tiering, or migrating large workloads off public-cloud object storage.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We’re looking for an outstanding engineering to join our Engine Scalability team. The Engine Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems. 
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences. 
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile. 
  • Drive projects end-to-end, collaborate with other engineers, and contribute to maintaining strong technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Real-time Performance Mindset: Experience diagnosing tradeoffs among CPU/GPU time, memory, loading latency, visual quality, and frame-time stability on constrained platforms such as mobile or console.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building production systems involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D asset pipelines, or GPU/client performance. Not required, but a major plus.
  • Ownership in Ambiguity: A track record of driving work end-to-end when the problem wasn't fully specified: defining the approach yourself, seeing it through implementation, rollout, and production consequences; gathering more information when requirements didn't make sense.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively across teams (Engine, Rendering, Avatar, Studio, and developer-facing teams) and explain complex technical topics clearly to different audiences.

  • Passion for systems: You have experience and good habits around building software and tools and getting them adopted. Your system's focus informs a view of code needing to be deeply reliable.

You Are:

  • A Partner: You know that the best tools integrate broadly with the tooling ecosystem. You approach partners and processes with curiosity and seek to understand a problem deeply before you start coding.

descriptionHtml:

Core Services builds the foundational services and software infrastructure behind Roblox’s global platform. Our work includes the C#/.NET and Rust frameworks, shared libraries, and runtime integrations that engineers use to build and operate production services.

As a Principal Software Engineer on the Core Services team you will solve problems spanning distributed systems, concurrency, memory management, API design, and developer experience. You will improve the performance and reliability of our C# ecosystem, expand our Rust infrastructure, and develop shared components and interoperability patterns across both languages. Your work will help teams adopt better foundations safely, with improvements that compound across Roblox’s service fleet.

This role combines hands-on systems engineering with technical leadership. You will work with service owners and infrastructure partners to turn complex platform capabilities into reliable, usable building blocks, and own their evolution from design through production adoption.

You Will

  • Build and evolve shared C#/.NET and Rust frameworks, libraries, and SDKs, including HTTP/gRPC infrastructure, caching, configuration, and observability.
  • Investigate performance from application code through the runtime: allocation pressure, garbage collection, lock contention, asynchronous execution, serialization, and network overhead.
  • Design safe, efficient managed/native interoperability with explicit ownership, error handling, cancellation, and compatibility contracts.
  • Create stable, usable APIs and lead their evolution across teams, balancing extensibility, performance, operational safety, and maintenance cost.
  • Build automation for framework upgrades and service migrations, including AI-assisted workflows supported by compatibility tests, benchmarks, traffic replay, and canary evidence.
  • Partner with deployment and service teams to make library changes easier to adopt, detect regressions early, and support safe rollout and rollback.
  • Lead ambiguous technical initiatives, mentor engineers, and measure outcomes in reliability, resource efficiency, adoption, and developer productivity.

You have

  • Deep production experience with the ability and interest to work effectively across multiple ecosystems. C# and Rust preferred, not required. 
  • Experience building and evolving reusable libraries, SDKs, frameworks, or runtime infrastructure adopted by multiple teams.
  • Strong fundamentals in concurrency, asynchronous programming, memory management, networking, and distributed systems.
  • A track record of diagnosing complex production problems and delivering measurable performance or reliability improvements.
  • Experience designing stable APIs and managing compatibility, versioning, dependencies, and adoption across dependent systems.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: framing ambiguous problems, explaining tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-team execution.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Particularly valuable experience

  • .NET runtime internals, GC and allocation optimization, thread-pool behavior, or production profiling.
  • Rust ownership and lifetimes, async runtimes, concurrent data structures, or performance-sensitive library design.
  • Managed/native interoperability, FFI, native memory diagnostics, or cross-platform packaging.
  • Contract-driven code generation, serialization, compatibility testing, or large-scale framework migrations.
  • Automated validation and rollout of shared dependencies across a service fleet.

As a Principal Software Engineer on the Engine DataModel team, you will own and innovate on the foundational components that form the backbone of the Roblox platform. In the Roblox Engine, the DataModel is a tree-like structure that is analogous to a scenegraph in other 3D engines. This role will report to the engineering manager and will be based out of our HQ in San Mateo, CA in a hybrid model 3 days a week (Tuesdays to Thursdays).

Our team owns:

  • The core structures and systems are used to build the DataModel and interact with it.
  • The C++ reflection bindings that form the Engine’s Luau API surface and let creators interact with the DataModel. We’ve built custom codegen tooling to generate the C++ for these reflection bindings and other related structures.
  • DataModel serialization … and much more!

You will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for all user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Build the core systems and data structures used in the Roblox engine, working with other teams to find universal solutions.
  • Take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles.
  • Execute code that performs well on all the devices Roblox supports—from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients.

You have:

  • Experience developing outstanding systems-level C++ programming.
  • Have experience working on game engine internals
  • Responsibility for building and maintaining systems that work optimally.
  • Curiosity to learn and stay up-to-date on technology developments.
  • Have a curiosity about the actual work the CPU does when you use smart pointers, templates, virtual functions, and blocks of memory, both structured and raw.

ML Platform powers hundreds of use cases and billions of inferences per day across Discovery, Safety, Economy, and Creation. We build the primitives that let teams train, evaluate, deploy, and operate models quickly and safely—so a new ML idea can reach production in weeks or less. We’re looking for a Principal Platform Engineer who treats platform as a product: someone who can turn complex ML/AI infrastructure into clear, durable APIs, SDKs and easy-to-use CLIs/UIs that our internal developers love.

This role blends product thinking, developer experience, backend engineering, and infrastructure at scale. Hands‑on ML experience is a plus; a track record of building internal platforms that developers love is a must.

You Are

  • Have 10+ years of professional experience and have a wealth of system design experience upon which to draw to build a scalable, reliable ML platform for all of Roblox.
  • A Code Machine; you love not only to design and communicate ideas but also to actually ship product. You obsess about user feedback, and constantly drive towards getting platform features in customers hands.
  • Proficient in API design and developer experience—gRPC/REST APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and simple UIs that developers love to use. 
  • Good to have - experience with the end‑to‑end ML model lifecycle such as model serving, training, model CI/CD, and GPU resources management, and have built ML platform features that are delightful to use.

  • Bootstrap and maintain core ML Platform components: Serving Layer, Model Registry, Pipeline Orchestrator, and Training/Inference control planes.
  • Set technical strategy and oversee development of high scale and reliable infrastructure systems, with clear SLOs for latency, availability, and cost.

descriptionHtml:

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. A single well-designed primitive or optimization here makes hundreds of internal engineers more productive and millions of player sessions smoother.

You Will:

  • Take ownership of part of the engine's Concurrency system — the task scheduler, fiber runtime, and async APIs that every other engine team builds on.
  • Research and implement performance improvements that unblock platform initiatives – unlocking higher fidelity and richer experiences.
  • Serve as a point of contact for concurrency across the org: design reviews, hard parallelism bugs, and asks from other engine teams.
  • Improve the ergonomics, testability, and debuggability of concurrent code across PC, Mac, mobile, and console.

You Have: 

  • Strong modern C++ (C++17 or newer) in a large, complex production codebase
  • Deep multithreading/concurrency experience — schedulers, thread pools, lock-free programming, atomics, memory models
  • Comfort profiling and reasoning about performance at the OS/CPU level

Nice to Have: 

  • Game engine or real-time systems experience
  • Fiber/coroutine runtimes, work-stealing or job-system schedulers
  • Cross-platform low-level development (Android, iOS, console)
  • Track record as the go-to expert other teams consult on a system

descriptionHtml:

Why Data Science And Engineering

The Data Science & Engineering organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency, and acumen in making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum, including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling, and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products, and measure impact on our community of players and developers.

In Data Science & Engineering, you will build the macroeconomic models, simulation frameworks, and policy mechanics that scale Roblox’s virtual economy. By analyzing Robux currency dynamics, global pricing strategies, and developer exchange policies, your work will directly inform strategic decision-making, financial policy, and executive roadmaps on our road to connecting one billion users.

You will: 

  • Develop, build, and refine macroeconomic models to forecast and monitor Robux money supply, velocity, inflation/deflation dynamics, and overall virtual economy health.
  • Model and inform comprehensive currency exchange policies, encompassing fiat-to-Robux purchase pricing, regional purchasing power (PPP) adjustments, and Developer Exchange (DevEx) rates, to balance global user participation, developer incentives, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Design and run counterfactual simulations (e.g. causal inference frameworks, agent-based modeling) to evaluate the impact of proposed monetary policies, sink/faucet adjustments, and marketplace fee changes before execution.
  • Analyze sink and faucet dynamics across the platform to balance liquidity, optimize developer economy mechanics, and prevent systemic economic imbalances.
  • Partner closely with Product and Finance leadership to translate complex economic data into actionable policy recommendations and sustainable growth strategies.
  • Establish robust economic indicators and monitoring systems to track real-time macro-health metrics, liquidity risks, and structural shifts in user behavior.
  • Communicate complex strategic findings and macroeconomic trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders to directly influence company-level roadmaps and economic policy decisions.
  • Promote technical excellence in quantitative policy analysis, econometrics, and simulation methodologies across the broader Data Science and Engineering team.

You have: 

  • 5+ years of industry or research experience applying quantitative economic modeling, econometrics, or simulation frameworks to analyze policy, marketplace dynamics, or user behavior.
  • Deep expertise in quantitative methodologies including time series forecasting (e.g., VAR, state-space models), causal inference (e.g., synthetic control, diff-in-diff), structural macro modeling (e.g., DSGE), and counterfactual simulation techniques (e.g., agent-based modeling).
  • Proven track record working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behaviors and aggregate them into macro-level economic insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead project areas from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks and iterative research deliverables.
  • Strong communication skills to explain complex economic trade-offs, risk scenarios, and simulation results to non-technical stakeholders in Finance and Product leadership.
  • An Advanced Degree (MSc or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

You are:

  • A systems thinker.
  • Curious and truth seeking.
  • A deep collaborator. You understand where your skills provide differential value and complement others, and how the strengths of others complement you.
  • Driven by strategic impact. You are passionate about informing high-stakes company decisions in complex, fast-moving environments.

title: Principal Data Scientist - Safety
descriptionHtml:

WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.

WHY CONTENT SAFETY?

Content safety and moderation are paramount to maintaining a positive, engaging, and trustworthy platform experience for our global community. In this role, you will apply your expertise in data science, statistics, and causal inference to strategically define, measure, and improve the detection and mitigation of harmful user-generated content and violative on-platform behaviors. Your focus will be on asset-based content across the platform - including games, avatars, and emerging in-game behaviors - by establishing reliable ground truth datasets and developing robust prevalence measurement methodologies. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy, and Compliance teams, acting as the quantitative expert who guides our defensive strategy against evolving safety threats and ensures accountability and scalable solutions. This is a critical opportunity to build innovative detection systems, define what we measure, and prove the impact of our safety efforts.

YOU WILL:

  • Establish and monitor robust prevalence measurement methodologies to accurately quantify the overall level of harmful content and behavior on the platform, providing the authoritative source of truth for organizational safety goals.
  • Develop and validate comprehensive ground truth datasets for harmful UGC and violative on-platform behaviors, ensuring high quality and alignment with the latest platform policies.
  • Deepen our understanding of violations by conducting exploratory analysis on current and emerging threat landscapes, providing data-backed recommendations on where Product and Engineering should strategically invest detection and moderation resources.
  • Design, implement, and analyze sophisticated experiments for new moderation and safety enforcement features, communicating results to our primary partners in Product and Engineering to guide development, while also collaborating closely with Policy, Compliance, and Legal teams for full strategic alignment.
  • Leverage advanced causal inference methodologies to accurately measure the effectiveness and potential systemic impacts of various safety initiatives on player experience and platform integrity.
  • Communicate strategic insights and present recommendations to leadership and all cross-functional partners, translating complex statistical findings on prevalence, ground truth quality, and effectiveness into actionable strategies for Product, Engineering, Policy, Compliance, and Legal
  • Partner with ML and Data Engineering teams to ensure model development, reporting, and detection systems are built on statistically sound ground truth and measurement frameworks.

YOU HAVE:

  • 10+ years of industry experience in data science, economics, analytics, or machine learning engineering
  • 7+ years of experience using scripting languages (Python, R), and big data query/processing languages and tools such as SQL, Hive, Spark, and Airflow
  • Knowledge of ML and Deep Learning either via formal training or industry experience
  • Ability to apply creative first-principles reasoning to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience developing large-scale safety or moderation systems as well as experience with content platforms, specifically user-generated content
  • Advanced Degree and/or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Math, Economics, or other related quantitative fields

As a Principal Software Engineer on Service Networking, you will set technical direction and lead hands-on development of the systems that make service-to-service communication reliable, secure, and efficient. You will guide the evolution of our Envoy- and Istio-based platform as services move across Kubernetes, Nomad, and cloud environments. You will partner with Compute, Security, and application teams, and help senior engineers lead complex technical work.

You will:

  • Set the technical strategy and roadmap for service mesh, balancing reliability, security, performance, and operating cost.
  • Design and build control-plane and data-plane capabilities for service discovery, routing, load balancing, and traffic policy using Envoy, Istio, and related technologies.
  • Lead integration and migration across Kubernetes, Nomad, and cloud environments, with clear compatibility requirements and safe rollout plans.
  • Partner with Security and application teams to deliver workload identity, mutual TLS, and traffic policy enforcement in production.
  • Improve resource efficiency and operational reliability through performance analysis, testing, observability, incident response, and deployment automation.

  • Expertise in service mesh, proxies, application gateways, or a closely related infrastructure domain, demonstrated through systems you have designed, shipped, and operated.
  • A strong understanding of networking fundamentals, service discovery, traffic management, failure isolation, and secure service communication.
  • Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Rust, or another systems language, with experience debugging across application, proxy, control-plane, and operating-system boundaries.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes or comparable orchestration platforms in production and leading infrastructure migrations or performance improvements. Envoy/Istio internals, xDS, workload identity, and substantive open-source contributions are especially relevant.

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer - Matchmaking
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Matchmaking is a critical stage downstream of Discovery and Search. Once a player chooses a game to play, matchmaking assigns them to a server for that game. That decision shapes who they play with, the network latency they experience, and the quality of their session. By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth.

As a Principal ML Engineer on Matchmaking, you’ll own the technical vision and execution for the models, objective functions, and algorithms that make those decisions. You’ll combine predictions of high-value player actions with optimization of player and developer utility and system efficiency, serving millions of players across hundreds of thousands of servers in global datacenters.

You Will:

  • Own the technical direction and ML strategy for matchmaking, connecting the Discovery and Search journey to server placements that improve player experience, developer success, and Roblox growth.
  • Define and evolve the matchmaking objective function to balance player and developer utility with system efficiency. Make tradeoffs among co-player compatibility, network and join latency, engagement, retention, server utilization, and compute cost explicit and measurable.
  • Build models that predict high-value actions and longer-term outcomes for each player–server match, including co-play, chat engagement, sustained play, and return visits, using player history, game characteristics, and live server state.
  • Design and productionize candidate-server retrieval, ranking, and assignment algorithms that optimize this objective under real-time latency, capacity, and reliability constraints, accounting for both the joining player and players already in the server.
  • Lead other engineers by example and through technical direction as an individual contributor, mentor engineers, and create an engineering culture of excellence.
  • Build and evolve the data, feature, training, serving, and evaluation systems that support matchmaking ML, ensuring fresh signals, reliable predictions, and consistency between training and serving.
  • Partner with Discovery, Search, developer-facing product teams, modelers, and data and AI infrastructure engineers to co-design models and systems that adapt to each game’s needs and deliver value across the player journey.
  • Define offline evaluation and lead online experiments to measure the impact of matchmaking decisions on player engagement and retention, developer success, and system efficiency, using the results to improve models and objectives.
  • Translate research into iterative production improvements, collaborate with the wider ML community where applicable, and represent Roblox’s technical work.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience and a consistent record of delivering and improving large-scale ML systems for ranking, recommendation, personalization, or resource allocation.
  • Experience defining objective functions, building predictive models, and deploying optimization algorithms that balance user and business outcomes with production latency, reliability, and resource constraints.
  • The capability of breaking down long-term product requirements into iterative deliverable stages.
  • Initiated and facilitated challenging technical decisions across multiple teams and organizations. You are empathetic and find common understanding.
  • Deep technical expertise, you always start with the needs of the user, whether they are Roblox users or internal engineers.
  • A generalist approach and you have mastered several languages and technologies already; you can easily adapt to any situation.
  • The ability to roll up your sleeves to tackle data problems or machine learning problems when they come up.
  • A creative and strategic approach to solving hard problems. You simplify the complex. You bring in fresh ideas from new places.
  • BS in Computer Science or a related discipline, MS/PhD are a definite plus.

descriptionHtml:

Why Roblox & Agent Infra

The Agent Infra team builds the infrastructure that runs autonomous AI agents at Roblox for millions of creators building experiences on our platform, and for thousands of Roblox engineers shipping production code every day.

Agent workloads break the assumptions most infrastructure is built on. They run for hours instead of milliseconds, they’re non-deterministic, they execute code nobody wrote, and they need real credentials against real systems to be useful at all. Making that safe, durable, and cost-effective at Roblox’s scale is the hard problem our team is solving.

As an early member of the Agent Infra team, you’ll work alongside an experienced engineering team on systems that are already in front of real users, at scale, in a field that didn’t exist two years ago.

You Are

  • Demonstrated experience: 8+ years building and operating backend, distributed, or infrastructure systems in production, including systems you designed that held up at scale for years.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of our core domains: workflow orchestration, scalable backend infrastructure, agentic runtimes, or secure sandboxing and access.
  • Hands-on: You spend most of your time building, and you write production code in Go, Python, Rust, or similar.
  • Agent-native: Agents drive your daily work. You’ve experimented with swarms, loops, and orchestration, you have strong opinions on harness and model choice, and you’re constantly evolving your agentic workflow.
  • Experienced with agents in production: You’ve run agents against real systems, seen how they fail, and know what the infrastructure underneath should do about it.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.

You Will

  • Set the technical direction: Own the design and implementation of Roblox’s core agent infrastructure, and scale it to serve every internal and external customer.
  • Drive reliability and security: Keep long-running agents alive through deploys, restarts, and outages. Run untrusted code in sandboxes that keep credentials out of the agent’s reach and control what it can reach on the network. Define the SLOs and observability that hold the platform to account.
  • Raise the bar: Keep learning and experimenting with agentic workflows, and bring what works to the team and the wider Foundation AI org.
  • Align across the org: Partner with Security, Engineering Efficiency, and Infrastructure so the agent platform and the systems it depends on are built in the same direction.
  • Multiply the team: Mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, and push how far agents can build the agent platform itself.

Nice to Have

  • Security experience with systems that run untrusted code: sandbox and container isolation (gVisor, Firecracker, microVMs), Kubernetes hardening, network segmentation and egress control.
  • Experience working with Temporal, AWS, and self-hosted models.
  • Experience building and deploying production systems on Kubernetes, using GitOps and Argo CD.
  • Contributions to open source or experience building your own product with real user traction.

As a member of the Roblox Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a key role in supporting the Security team’s mission. The GRC team is at the heart of Roblox's security organization — empowering every builder to make risk-informed decisions by establishing a portfolio of governing policies and standards, a repeatable and scalable method of assessing and quantifying risk, and a formal oversight process for GRC capabilities across Roblox.

Our program takes a balanced, "right-sized" approach to security governance — combining qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to assess and prioritize the security risks that matter most to Roblox. GRC partners closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership — including providing regular reporting to the Board of Directors and the Audit & Compliance Committee — to ensure that security risk is visible, well-understood, and actioned appropriately.

The Economy ML team is building the machine learning backbone for Roblox’s virtual economy - from intelligent pricing and personalized storefronts to dynamic layout optimization and avatar content understanding. We partner closely with Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization to deliver ML systems that drive long‑term value across engagement, retention, and creator earnings.

As a Senior ML Software Engineer on the team, you will build the infrastructure and backend services that train, serve, and integrate the models powering ranking, personalization, and pricing across Roblox’s economic surfaces, including Marketplace, Developer Monetization, and Payments. Your work determines how quickly we can take new models from idea to production, and how well they perform once they are serving millions of users.

You Will

  • Build and operate the training infrastructure behind Economy ML’s ranking, recommendation, and pricing models: distributed training jobs, efficient data loading, and reproducible pipelines from raw data to trained model.
  • Co-design models and systems with ML engineers: profile and optimize training and inference for our ranking and recommendation models, improving GPU utilization, memory, throughput, and latency (e.g., moving models to GPU serving, request batching, mixed precision, faster request-time feature processing).
  • Design and build the backend services and APIs that bring model predictions into Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, with clear latency budgets and graceful fallbacks.
  • Build and scale the batch and real-time data and feature pipelines that feed training and serving, with a focus on freshness, correctness, and training/serving consistency.
  • Own the path from trained model to production serving: packaging, deployment, versioning, shadow and canary rollouts, and integration with A/B experiments on Roblox’s ML platform.
  • Make the systems you own reliable and observable, and set the team’s best practices for logging, monitoring, alerting, and on-call across ML services.
  • Partner with Roblox’s central ML platform and data infrastructure teams, and with Marketplace / Economy backend teams, to adopt shared infrastructure and contribute improvements back to it.
  • Contribute to the technical direction of the Economy ML team: help shape our training and serving stack, infrastructure roadmap, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and cost.
  • Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, helping raise the technical bar of the broader Economy organization.

You Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and operating ML infrastructure or ML-backed production services at high scale. Experience with recommendation, search, or ads systems is a strong plus.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals in Python and at least one other backend language, with a track record of designing and operating distributed, low-latency services.
  • Hands-on experience training and serving deep learning models in production with PyTorch, including scaling training across GPUs and nodes and deploying models on GPU inference servers. Comfortable profiling and optimizing for utilization, memory, latency, and cost.
  • Experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and feature stores (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka), with attention to data quality and training/serving skew.
  • You build systems that are easy to debug and operate, and you take ownership of production health, from monitoring and alerting to incident response.
  • You enjoy working closely with ML engineers, platform teams, product managers, and data scientists across Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, and you can drive alignment in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • You understand how infrastructure choices (latency, freshness, cost) affect model quality and product metrics, and you prioritize work by its impact on users, creators, and the business.
  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

descriptionHtml:

About Roblox Live

Roblox Live creates the moments that bring Roblox together. We turn music, entertainment, culture, and the creativity of our community into new ways to play and connect. From major platform celebrations to live performances and breakout creator moments, we give players something to show up for, experience with friends, and come back to.

We’re a small, fast-moving team with the ambition to shape the future of live experiences on Roblox. We bring ideas to life with creators and partners, build the technology that makes them possible, and turn what works into tools that let the creator community take it further.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Live Ops Producer to run Roblox’s shared moments from launch readiness through event close. You will own launch sequencing, the war room, in-flight operational calls, reward validation, and day-to-day communications with development partners. You’ll keep launches coordinated and respond quickly when players need a fix.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with strong production craft and calm judgment under pressure. You’ll coordinate studios, developers, and internal teams across overlapping events, working with the Senior Program Manager on dependencies and the Platform Events Designer on tuning. Our global event calendar includes planned coverage on evenings, weekends, and holidays.

You Will

  • Build the production and readiness plan with studios and internal leads. Define delivery milestones, integration deadlines, test plans, and launch criteria, and feed dependencies into the program calendar.
  • Coordinate rehearsals and required QA, performance, security, policy, localization, and support reviews. Track issues to resolution and make go/no-go recommendations based on readiness.
  • Write and run the launch run-of-show across the hub, participating experiences, content drops, rewards, and player entry points. Confirm timing, owners, and contingencies for each step.
  • Coordinate launch timing with engineering, marketing, and developers. Validate each release step before moving to the next, and record decisions and changes.
  • Staff and lead the war room. Establish monitoring, coverage, incident priorities, and escalation paths for the full live window.
  • Make operational calls within agreed decision rights. Coordinate release timing, hotfixes, pauses, and recovery with engineering, and implement gameplay and economy changes with the designer.
  • Monitor event health, reward delivery, player reports, and sentiment with Data Science, support, and community teams. Prioritize actions and keep partners informed through resolution.
  • Validate reward availability, eligibility, progression tracking, award delivery, and release timing. Test the full player journey across the hub and participating experiences.
  • Coordinate winner validation with security, legal, and support for scarce rewards or competitions. Investigate failed or incorrect awards and coordinate fixes and player remediation.
  • Be the primary operational contact for studios and participating developers. Set expectations on milestones, integration requirements, readiness, and live changes.
  • Resolve delivery blockers, route design decisions to the designer, and escalate technical issues to internal owners. Give developers timely information to plan around their own games and communities.
  • Maintain launch checklists, incident procedures, and operational runbooks. Contribute findings and partner feedback to the Senior Program Manager’s retrospectives and post-event playbooks.
  • Identify recurring integration, monitoring, and reward problems. Partner with product and engineering on tools and automation that make events easier to run.

You Have

  • 7+ years in game production, live operations, or live event production, including significant experience on a live-service game or recurring content calendar.
  • Direct experience launching and operating in-game events, seasons, or content drops, with ownership of readiness reviews and release sequencing.
  • Experience leading live incident response and making timely decisions with incomplete information, including coordinating hotfixes and recovery.
  • A track record of managing delivery and communications with external studios, developers, or production partners.
  • Working knowledge of progression, virtual economies, and reward pipelines, with experience validating eligibility and award delivery.
  • Fluency with event telemetry and player feedback, and the ability to turn operational signals into clear priorities.
  • Strong written communication and production discipline, with experience using tools such as Jira, Airtable, Asana, or equivalents to keep complex launches organized.
  • Familiarity with Roblox development workflows, avatar items, and its player and creator communities (preferred).
  • Experience producing live broadcasts, in-game performances, or creator- and influencer-led programming (preferred).
  • Experience with competitive events, winner validation, or exploit response (preferred).
  • Experience operating for a global audience or building launch and incident runbooks from scratch (preferred).
