We’re hiring a Senior People Business Partner to be the senior people strategist for User. You'll sit on the group leadership team as a trusted advisor to the group's senior engineering leader and their staff. You'll own the multi-year people strategy that lets User ship an ambitious roadmap while growing the leaders and builders who deliver it. You'll partner with a People Business Associate who supports frontline managers, so your time goes to org design, leadership bench, and group health, not straightforward manager and employee questions.

User is the group that builds what most people think of as “Roblox”. The app they open on their phone, console, or desktop, the friends they find and keep, the ways they chat and share moments, and the communities and first party live events they experience. It's a large, engineering-heavy group of engineering, product, design, and data science teams working across the Social (Communication, Community, Connection, Sharing), Consumer Apps, and Live teams. The work is highly interdependent, what one team ships usually depends on several other teams and functions.

You’ll join the People Business Partner team in People & Systems and report to the Senior Director, People Business Partner Lead.

You will

  • Co-create User's multi-year people strategy - Work with group leadership to turn product strategy into an annual people plan and a multi-year talent roadmap covering capability gaps, succession, future skills, and where to invest
  • Diagnose and improve the system, not treat the symptom - Analyze User's operating model, org design, spans and layers, and talent systems to find friction and misalignment with the business strategy. Then build the case for structural change and see it through
  • Orchestrate change across teams - Lead large, multi-team changes, including reorgs, team integrations, and new operating rhythms, so leaders can keep shipping while the org evolves
  • Build the leadership bench - Partner with senior leaders on a long-term plan for leadership capability and succession across the group. Make sure development plans are real and in use, and treat RoGRO as one input, not the endpoint
  • Bring data to the leadership table - Combine internal people data (engagement, attrition, performance, progression) with external research to produce forward-looking insights that change decisions. Help leaders read the signal, not just the dashboard or report
  • Use AI to work differently - Use AI tools to speed up analysis, synthesis, and program design. Help User's leaders think through how AI changes team design, skills, and the work of managers
  • Shape culture with leaders - Use people data to find systemic barriers to engagement and inclusion, and design interventions that reflect Roblox's values. Hold senior leaders to their people commitments, courageously and constructively
  • Make User a place great builders choose - Shape hiring programs, capacity planning, and employer brand for the group so User attracts and keeps the talent it needs

You have

  • 10+ years in HR, people strategy, or organizational effectiveness, including significant time as a senior PBP/HRBP partnering with VP-level leaders in engineering-centric, product-driven technology organizations
  • A track record of org design and change at scale: reorgs, operating model shifts, or integrations affecting hundreds of people, with outcomes you can measure
  • Built and owned multi-year talent strategies: succession and bench planning, workforce planning (build / buy / borrow), and leadership development that moved readiness metrics
  • Strong analytical judgment. You're comfortable working directly with people data, partnering with People Analytics, and turning complex findings into a clear narrative for senior leaders
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and curiosity about how AI is changing team design and the role of managers
  • Executive presence and courage: you influence senior technical leaders through credibility and evidence, and you'll tell them what they need to hear
  • Discretion with highly confidential information, and comfort operating in ambiguity at the pace of a founder-led company

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting consumer, social, or communications products at scale, or mobile and cross-platform app organizations
  • Background in I-O psychology, organization development, or an equivalent evidence-based approaches to how people work
  • Experience in a PBP/associate (or HRBP/HR generalist) partnership model where you have mentored and partnered closely with partner functions

title: Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, Matchmaking
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

Matchmaking is a critical stage downstream of Discovery and Search. Once a player chooses a game to play, matchmaking assigns them to a server for that game. That decision shapes who they play with, the network latency they experience, and the quality of their session. By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth.

As a Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll build scalable, reliable, and high-performance infrastructure that powers ML systems across our organization. You’ll operate at the scales of tens of billions of scorings, and redefine how we match hundreds of millions of users to millions of games.

You will:

  • Work at the intersection of model architecture and ML infrastructure, partnering closely with core modelers, data and AI infrastructure engineers, and product teams to push the boundaries of large-scale training and serving. 
  • Design and own large-scale data engineering and streaming systems that power ML, including real-time event ingestion, streaming feature computation, training-data generation, and data quality and freshness guarantees. This includes building low-latency pipelines with technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and Ray, and keeping online and offline features consistent.
  • Build online and continual learning systems that let models adapt to user behavior and content shifts in near real time. This includes incremental and streaming training, online model updates and fast model refresh, embedding and parameter-server synchronization, delayed-feedback and label-joining pipelines, and safe deployment through monitoring, drift detection, and automated rollback.
  • Investigate model, data, and systems tradeoffs end to end, from streaming data pipelines and distributed training to low-latency inference and production serving. This includes designing efficient cache strategies, applying pruning and quantization, optimizing GPU utilization and memory efficiency, and developing custom kernels where needed.
  • Own the architecture, establish engineering best practices of scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of ML infrastructure (e.g., training, serving, feature). You have deep production experience with low-latency key-value stores and feature registries like Redis, Feast, Tecton, or Cassandra.
  • Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, platform teams, and product stakeholders to design, implement, and operate robust ML platforms that accelerate model development and deployment.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends in machine learning and infrastructure to ensure the adoption of leading-edge technologies and practices.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale machine learning and data systems in production environments.
  • 3+ years of experience tech-leading ML infrastructure or data engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale streaming and data processing systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Spark, Beam) and real-time feature pipelines.
  • Experience building or operating online, incremental, or continual learning systems for recommendation, ranking, or search is a strong plus.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

We are also launching Compute Functions, which provide developers with a new surface to execute game logic for more robust features such as custom matchmaking, limited inventory drops, or any background task processing. However, our scope extends to full stack projects spanning all the way from the infrastructure layer, through engine development, data pipelines, microservices, telemetry, game servers, web development, UI, and UX design. This team collaborates on multiple cross-company efforts and our projects are of extremely high importance to Roblox. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Principal Software Engineer on the Roblox Programmability team, you will work with us on software ecosystem development of the embedded scripting languages in the Roblox engine while working with the Engineering Director. To enable developers on the Roblox platform to build tomorrow's top games, they require more than a functional scripting environment; they need sophisticated programming interfaces, a robust set of script libraries, comprehensive development tools, and an ultra-fast, multithreaded runtime. Join our team to guide the evolution of a new suite of programming interfaces and sophisticated tooling features that millions of developers will use daily. You will play a pivotal role in this process.

You Will:

  • Contribute to the design and development of programming models that improve script performance and scalability
  • Develop prototypes to validate designs against realistic use cases, ensuring they meet our performance and functionality standards
  • Take ownership of new feature development from concept and prototyping through to deployment and maintenance
  • Improve the adaptability and performance of existing components
  • Collaborate with engineers across engine and partner teams to build collaborative solutions

You Have:

  • Over 10+ years of experience developing and deploying user-facing software products
  • A minimum of Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
  • Proficiency in C++ and an understanding of parallel/concurrent programming concepts
  • Experience with API and tool development, game development, distributed systems, and Lua/Luau programming is a plus
  • A grasp of industry standards and design patterns
  • The ability to analyze and approach problems from multiple perspectives, weighing the advantages and drawbacks of different solutions

You Are:

  • Enthusiastic about crafting software programming environments for game developers, eager to apply insights from multiple programming ecosystems to our scripting environment
  • Self-driven, able to navigate complex codebases with minimal guidance
  • Reliable, developing systems that are not just effective but also resilient over time
  • Inquisitive, constantly learning and staying on top of the latest trends in scripting languages and programming environments

The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution.

You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Manager of Product Support Incident management, you’ll be focused on managing the team that manages technical escalations, supports product reliability, process improvement and design along with playing a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform. 

You will coordinate across multiple teams to ensure rapid response to minimize the impact on customers and business operations, identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.

This role requires participation in a shift rotation to maintain 24/7 operations, which includes on-call duties and weekend coverage.

You Will:

  • Lead and Mentor: Manage a high-performing team of Specialists responsible for incident response and technical escalations, providing coaching, development, and performance management.
  • Drive Issue Management: Oversee the end-to-end incident management lifecycle within support operations, ensuring the team meets SLAs for critical and high-severity issues while serving as the final point of escalation for complex issues.
  • Incident Management Strategy: Coordinate the incident response activities, gather the response team, and set up a virtual command center for communication and collaboration. Due to its potential impact, critical decisions must be made to classify the incident, and be willing to participate in on-call support for incident management issues. Along with this, you will be responsible for providing regular updates and reports to upper management on the status of operations, including performance metrics and any issues encountered.
  • Cross Function Collaboration - Collaborate with Knowledge Management, Training and Quality Assurance teams to ensure process adherence, identify areas for improvement in support workflows, and implement quality control measures.
  • Strategic Partner to Product Support - Is a strategic thought partner to product support, aligning on goals and objectives for launch readiness and building in quality escalation and issue management principals to readiness initiatives.

You Have:

  • Management Experience: 10+ years of experience in technical support or operations, with at least 2+ years in a people management role, preferably within a high-growth tech environment..
  • Advanced Problem Solving: Strong ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business strategies. Proficiency in SQL or Python to audit team dashboards and validate data-driven decisions is highly preferred.
  • Process Improvement: Demonstrated success in reducing operating costs and improving Automation Rate/ Contact Rate/CSAT/Quality scores.
  • Systems Fluency: Deep familiarity with the architecture of CRM tools (Zendesk), Jira, and automated ticketing workflows.

You Are:

  • Innovative: You proactively identify emerging risks and execute on out of the box ideas to achieve goals.
  • A Strategic Leader: You look beyond the immediate incident to solve for the root cause and prevent future friction at scale.
  • Growth-Oriented: You are invested in your team’s success, fostering an inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning.
  • A Master Communicator: You can distill highly technical incidents into concise "so-what" summaries for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  • Data-Driven: Uses data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decision-making.

About the role:

Foundation AI builds the platforms, services, and infrastructure that enable machine learning and generative AI across Roblox. As a Principal Engineer on this team, you'll set technical strategy and direction across areas such as model training and inference, LLM services, agent infrastructure, data systems, experimentation, evaluation, and developer tooling. You'll be accountable for the architecture and long-term health of systems that many teams depend on, and you'll shape how Roblox builds AI — partnering with engineering, product, research, data, infrastructure, safety, creator, engine, discovery, and economy. You will report to an Engineering Manager within the Foundation AI organization.

You will:

  • Define the multi-year technical vision and architecture for platforms and services that power machine learning, generative AI, and agentic experiences across Roblox.
  • Drive the hardest, most ambiguous, highest-leverage problems on the platform from framing through production on multi-provider inference resiliency and scaling information retrieval infrastructure for agentic use and be accountable for the outcomes.
  • Establish the standards, paved paths, and guardrails that make the platform self-serve for every team at Roblox — multi-tenant usage attribution and metering, built-in spend controls, and fast, ticket-free onboarding.
  • Make foundational trade-offs in quality, latency, reliability, cost, and responsible data use for systems operating at Roblox scale — treating instrumentation and observability as a first principle of the architecture, not an afterthought.
  • Own the operational standard for the platform at scale — SLOs, capacity planning, on-call, and incident response and design for graceful degradation and fast recovery, not just steady-state correctness.
  • Identify high-impact opportunities and risks ahead, and build alignment across engineering and leadership to act on them.
  • Multiply the impact of other engineers through technical mentorship, design and code review, and setting the bar for engineering excellence.

You have:

  • An undergraduate/graduate degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience building and operating large-scale production software, distributed systems, cloud services, or related infrastructure.
  • A sustained track record of designing and owning foundational systems or platforms with organization- or company-wide impact.
  • Deep expertise in one or more of machine learning, generative AI, distributed systems, data infrastructure, or developer platforms, with the breadth to reason across all of them.
  • Expert proficiency in one or more of Go, Python, or Rust, and the judgment to choose the right tools for durable systems.
  • A history of setting technical direction across multiple teams and driving large, cross-organizational efforts to completion.
  • Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, product, and leadership around a technical strategy.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or operating an LLM gateway, inference-serving, or model-routing layer — multi-provider failover, rate limiting, and token/cost accounting at scale.
  • Hands-on work with vector databases, similarity search, or knowledge graphs, and with RAG or agentic systems (retrieval pipelines, agent memory, context management, evaluating non-deterministic systems).
  • Experience designing multi-tenant platforms — usage attribution, metering, spend controls, and self-serve onboarding.
  • Background in GPU infrastructure or ML inference efficiency (batching, quantization, accelerator utilization, cost optimization).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Realtime Analytics Platform
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Your Role:

Roblox's data infrastructure processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Real-time Analytics Platform team, you will design, build, and scale the core OLAP infrastructure powering sub-second analytical queries across Roblox. Our team directly owns and operates StarRocks and Apache Druid, driving high-throughput streaming ingestion and low-latency MPP query processing. You will lead the next-generation architecture of our real-time analytics platform, combining high ownership and deep technical complexity to push the boundaries of MPP engine performance, streaming ingestion pipelines, and cluster scalability. 

You Will:

  • Own and Scale Core OLAP Platforms: Take end-to-end ownership of the architecture, operational health, and scalability of our high-throughput OLAP engines, specifically StarRocks and Apache Druid. 
  • Optimize Query Engine Performance: Dive deep into engine internals, cost-based optimization (CBO), query planning, vectorized execution, memory optimization, and serialization efficiency to maximize throughput and maintain sub-second latency under heavy concurrent load. 
  • Architect Streaming Ingestion Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize real-time data ingestion paths leveraging Apache Kafka, Apache Flink and native engine load mechanisms.
  • Drive OLAP Data Modeling Best Practices: Partner with infra, data science, and product engineering teams to guide data modeling for MPP databases, optimizing partitioning, bucketing, sort keys, and materialized views. 
  • Manage Cluster Infrastructure & Capacity: Lead cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, operations, and capacity planning using Kubernetes and Terraform across cloud environments. 
  • Advance Autonomous Interfaces: Integrate AI/ML and LLM-driven capabilities within our query platforms to enable automated self-serve mechanisms and intelligent data discovery for engineers. 

You Have:

  • 6+ years of experience building, designing, testing and maintaining production-grade, large-scale distributed systems.
  • Deep OLAP & MPP Engine Depth: Strong hands-on engineering or operational experience with StarRocks or adjacent OLAP engines such as Apache Druid, ClickHouse, Apache Doris, Apache Pinot, or Trino/Presto. 
  • Streaming & Ingestion Architecture: Proven track record implementing high-volume streaming ingestion using Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Routine Load / Broker Load, or Debezium/CDC pipelines.
  • Data Modeling & Query Optimization: Expertise in OLAP schema design (partitioning, bucketing, sort keys, indexing) and tuning cost-based SQL query engines for massive scale.
  • Strong Engineering Foundations: Robust proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or Scala, with a track record of writing clean, highly performant distributed backend code. 
  • Infrastructure & Orchestration: Experience operating, troubleshooting, and provisioning data infrastructure at scale using Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS or GCP. 
  • Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on complex cross-cutting initiatives.
  • B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience.
  • Bonus Points:
    • Core contributions to open-source OLAP databases (StarRocks, Apache Druid, ClickHouse, Apache Doris).
    • Experience operating real-time analytical platforms at consumer-internet scale (100M+ active users).

  • Draft and deliver real-time, high-stakes communications to senior leadership regarding incident status, impact assessment, and mitigation efforts.
  • Apply sound judgment in triage, lane assignment, escalation, and case closure.
  • Develop, test, and maintain robust incident response playbooks for critical harms scenarios.
  • Improve our investigative methods, operating processes, templates, and quality standards.
  • Build trust with cross-functional partners and mentor others to strengthen our investigative capabilities.

You Have:

  • 5+ years leading investigations, incident management, and/or policy enforcement on a technology platform.
  • Demonstrated ability thriving in high-pressure, sensitive, and complex investigations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical and sensitive issues to executive audiences and non-technical partners.
  • Fluency with data analysis, dashboards, and a range of investigation tools; familiarity with online safety considerations.
  • Strong project management skills, prioritization acumen, and enthusiasm to build processes from the ground up.
  • Demonstrated mentorship, informal leadership, and subject-matter expertise that helps other investigators grow.
  • Outstanding judgment, discretion, collegiality, and resilience.

The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.

You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.

Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence. 


You Will

Support health and proactive gap identification

  • Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
  • Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
  • Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
  • Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc) 
  • Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
  • Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.


Knowledge & Support Content

  • Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
  • Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on. 
  • Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
  • Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place

  • A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
  • Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
  • Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.

  • Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
  • Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.

Every day, millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect. Our Safety Investigations team helps make those experiences safer by identifying and disrupting severe abuse, understanding the actors and networks behind it, and turning complex investigative findings into clear action.

As a Safety Threat Investigator on the Safety Investigations team, you will primarily support Roblox’s Core Investigations capability: the operational backbone for repeatable, high-sensitivity matters that require speed, consistency, evidence discipline, and strong documentation. You will independently manage investigations from intake through resolution and produce clear, defensible work product that supports high-confidence safety decisions.

You will also identify when a matter requires deeper attribution, network-centric analysis, cross-platform research, proactive threat hunting, or externally meaningful work product, and partner with or escalate to Specialized Investigations as appropriate. At the CL9 level, you will own a defined safety-risk domain or pod-level workstream, improve investigative processes and standards, serve as a subject-matter expert, and mentor other investigators with limited day-to-day oversight.

Please note: This role may require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. It may also require participation in an on-call rotation during weekends and holidays.

You Will

  • Own repeatable, high-sensitivity investigations involving serious safety threats, including child exploitation, violent extremism, organized fraud, compromised accounts, coordinated abuse, and other high-risk matters.
  • Apply structured investigative methods, evidence checklists, common templates, and approved data pulls to produce timely and consistent case outcomes.
  • Gather, preserve, analyze, and corroborate evidence while maintaining accurate provenance, confidentiality, and auditability.
  • Define investigative questions, scope, hypotheses, evidence plans, milestones, risk controls, and exit criteria for sensitive or ambiguous matters.
  • Conduct focused account, entity, and timeline linkage as needed, and identify when a case requires deeper attribution, network mapping, or cross-platform investigation.
  • Escalate cases to Specialized Investigations when they develop meaningful attribution complexity, broader network risk, external actionability, or a need for deeper synthesis.
  • Prepare clear case summaries and standardized downstream work product for partners such as Legal, Safety Intelligence, Trust & Safety Operations, Law Enforcement Operations, or NCMEC, as appropriate.
  • Track recurring patterns, operational pain points, and escalation trends, and translate findings into recommendations for Policy, Product, Engineering, Detection, Legal, and Safety Operations.
  • Lead or contribute to durable improvements such as investigation playbooks, evidence standards, intake criteria, triage processes, tooling requirements, and quality-review mechanisms.
  • Represent Safety Investigations with cross-functional stakeholders, explain and defend investigative decisions, navigate disagreement, and maintain alignment on sensitive matters.
  • Mentor investigators, provide constructive feedback on casework, and raise the team’s standards for investigative rigor, documentation, and inclusive collaboration.
  • Maintain strong case hygiene, document decisions and approvals, and ensure investigations are closed with clear outcomes, residual-risk ownership, and follow-up actions.

You Have

  • 4+ years conducting sensitive investigations involving severe safety, abuse, fraud, security, threat, or other high-risk matters.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage investigations end-to-end, including intake, scoping, evidence development, analysis, findings, recommendations, and follow-through.
  • Experience using SQL and/or Python, large datasets, and open-source intelligence in an investigative context.
  • Strong investigative judgment and the ability to distinguish facts, inferences, allegations, unknowns, assumptions, and analytical conclusions.
  • Experience with attribution, account or entity linkage, network analysis, open-source intelligence, external intelligence, or cross-platform research.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and defensible work product for investigators, leadership, Legal, Product, Engineering, and external-facing stakeholders.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous questions into precise investigation plans and drive complex, multi-week or multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Systems-oriented thinking and the ability to connect individual cases to policy, product, process, detection, legal, reputational, and user-trust considerations.
  • Experience influencing partners and creating alignment in high-stakes or time-sensitive situations.
  • Demonstrated mentorship, informal leadership, or subject-matter expertise that helps other investigators grow.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to evidence-based, fair, and proportionate investigations.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will be expected to independently manage Core Investigations matters from intake to completion, deliver consistent and defensible work product, identify cases that warrant escalation, provide practical insights from your investigations, and own a meaningful process-improvement project or risk domain.

You will be successful when you:

  • Deliver rigorous, timely, and consistent outcomes on high-sensitivity investigations.
  • Apply sound judgment in triage, lane assignment, escalation, and case closure.
  • Improve the team’s investigative methods, operating processes, templates, and quality standards.
  • Convert case findings into concrete safety improvements and upstream action.
  • Build trust with cross-functional partners and mentor others to strengthen the team’s investigative capability.

Our Team Principles

We follow the full story, investigate horizontally, make safety impact real, pursue accountability end-to-end, lead with mission and curiosity, collaborate with candor and respect, build leverage rather than relying on heroics, and continuously raise the bar.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You Have: 

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
  • Experience with large-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement.

You will:

  • Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source.
  • Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox.
  • Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident.
  • Design idempotent, exactly-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on.
  • Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth.
  • Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence.

title: Lead, Support Operations Excellence

The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox's Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. The team provides support to Roblox's global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Lead, Product Support Ops on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll be mentor and lead the team that is focused on Escalations, Product Reliability, Process Improvement and Design and plays a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform. Your team will be responsible for identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.

You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager and leading the Support Operations Excellence team, providing coverage across billing, accounts, creator, and adjacent domains. This is a player-coach role, weighted toward leadership. You'll still go deep on the hardest problems and stay close enough to the work to be a genuine execution expert, but your primary leverage is the team, and you'll be measured on what they collectively deliver. 

The Product Support Management (PSM) team is your most important partner. You and your team supply the synthesis, evidence, and prioritization that enable PSM and engineering to fix problems at the source, and you are accountable for the quality of what reaches them.

You Will

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage, coach, and grow a team of four Product Support Specialists (i.e. Process Excellence team), owning onboarding, performance, and career development. You’ll set direction and hold the quality of output for the team. Coach them to grow their scope and operate with independence.
  • Set clear standards for what good looks like at each level, and give direct, specific, and frequent feedback against them.
  • Represent the team's work, constraints, and priorities to leadership and to cross-functional partners.


Partner with the Product Support Management team

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the Product Support Specialists team and Product Support Managers (PSM's), ensuring the issues your team surfaces arrive with the synthesis, evidence, and recommendation needed to act on them.
  • Own the quality bar for what your team escalates into the PSM and engineering prioritization process.
  • Ensure RCAs are completed, documented, socialized with the right stakeholders, and work with the PSM team to ensure they are translated into changes that prevent recurrence.
  • Step in personally on the highest-stakes and most ambiguous problems, and partner with the PSM team to make the call when the path forward is unclear.

Drive support health and operational excellence

  • Co-own the health of product support across your domains: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where users are getting stuck.
  • Turn patterns into prioritized action: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, and product gaps get surfaced with a recommendation.
  • Hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, and eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling. 
  • Support Launches:
    • Get ahead of launches: make sure upcoming product and policy changes are pressure-tested from a support perspective, and that content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before users feel the change.
    • Contribute to the successful launch of new support streams and initiatives by providing subject matter expertise, process guidance, and team capacity.
  • Partner closely with the PSM team to establish a regular feedback loop on support health proactively identifying areas of strength, flagging degrading performance, and driving actionable mitigation plans.
  • Vendor & Escalation Quality: Partner with vendor operations (BPO/Tier 1) to establish feedback loops that improve first-contact resolution, reduce bad escalations, and ensure frontline agents are enabled on critical product changes.

Knowledge & Support ContentOwn knowledge and scaled support

  • Co-own the accuracy/ information within support content that agents depend on along with PSMs, ensuring workflows, policies and guidance are accurate and up to date. Ensure support content which includes but is not limited to,  troubleshooting guides, decision trees, structured resolution paths, policy interpretations are clear, current, and reliable for the support agents who use it.
  • Partner with Knowledge Management, Training, and Quality teams to align documentation, agent enablement, and quality control with what the data says users actually need.

You Have

  • 8+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
  • Direct people management experience, including ownership of performance and career development, with a track record of developing individuals and raising the collective performance of a team.
  • A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues, and the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to delegate.
  • Experience owning incident response for high-severity issues, including coordinating cross-functional teams under time pressure.
  • Breadth across multiple support domains, or clear evidence you can get up to speed on an unfamiliar one quickly.
  • Excellent written communication. You can explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer, to a frustrated user, and to leadership, and all three come away clearer.
  • Strong cross-functional influence without authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You set direction for your team when the problem space is not yet well defined.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call support when needed.

You Are

  • A Leader: Your team does better work because of you, and that shows up in their output and their growth.
  • Analytical: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous problems, and to measure both the problems and the solutions.
  • A proactive problem solver: You anticipate problems and take decisive action rather than waiting for them to escalate to you.
  • Team-oriented: You lift up your peers and find ways to make the wider organization stronger, not just your own team.
  • Data-driven: You use data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decisions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
  • Experience building or scaling a support team through a period of significant growth or change.
  • Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience alongside a general consumer base.
  • Experience working with BPO or outsourced support partners.

You will join the Security and Privacy GRC team, reporting to the Sr Engineering Manager for Privacy Governance and Operations. This is a hands-on privacy engineering role: you'll set standards for privacy-enhancing technologies, act as the go-to SME for policy-as-code, and partner closely with Product teams, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Regulatory Compliance as part of Roblox's broader cross-functional privacy program.

You will:

  • Shepherd and evolve the Privacy Review Program, designing consistent intake workflows, evaluation criteria, and documentation to systematically assess privacy risk across new products, features, and infrastructure changes.
  • Develop standards and guidelines that enable product teams to adopt privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, data minimization, and secure computation, with clear guidance on trade-offs and implementation patterns.
  • Act as the Privacy SME for policy-as-code, translating privacy requirements and regulatory obligations into automated, enforceable controls embedded directly into engineering workflows and infrastructure.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Regulatory Compliance, Trust & Safety, and Legal to align Privacy Review Program outcomes with broader compliance obligations and evolving global privacy frameworks.
  • Drive privacy-by-design adoption across product and engineering organizations through self-service tooling, consultation, and scalable enablement programs.
  • Communicate privacy risk posture and program health to product stakeholders and cross-functional partners, turning complex technical findings into clear, actionable guidance.

You have:

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in privacy engineering, privacy program management, or a related security/compliance discipline.
  • Experience owning or significantly shaping a privacy review process, privacy governance function, or equivalent, including designing review workflows, managing stakeholder intake, and driving decisions to closure.
  • Deep expertise in privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), such as differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, k-anonymity, federated learning, and secure multi-party computation; and sound judgment about their real-world trade-offs in production environments.
  • Experience identifying and mitigating privacy vulnerabilities in data systems, including identifiability risks such as inference, linkage, and homogeneity attacks, and other privacy risks more broadly.
  • Hands-on experience with policy-as-code tooling for automating compliance enforcement in engineering pipelines (e.g., OPA/Rego, Cedar, or similar policy engines).
  • Strong understanding of global data protection regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, COPPA, and LGPD; and the technical implications of each for product and infrastructure design.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, legal, policy, and compliance stakeholders without direct management authority.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a similar technical field.

You are:

    • A skilled translator: You articulate technical privacy trade-offs to legal and compliance audiences, and unpack regulatory requirements clearly for engineering teams.
    • Organized and process-oriented: You manage multiple concurrent program tracks with precision and accountability in a fast-moving environment.
    • Comfortable with ambiguity: You build structure and rigor where little exists, take ownership of outcomes, and know when to drive autonomously versus escalate.
    • Collaborative: You move work forward across teams you don't directly manage and build trust quickly with diverse stakeholders.
    • Genuinely invested in user privacy: You see it as a core product and platform value, not a compliance formality, and you make the case for it compellingly.

descriptionHtml:

WHY SAFETY?

At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world.

WHY ACCESS & CONTROLS?

Roblox operates globally across a huge number of jurisdictions, each with their own laws and regulations. Every user’s platform experience is tailored based on their age, location, parental consents, and more to ensure that Roblox is safe and compliant for them. The Access & Controls pod owns the systems that make this possible. Our platforms allow internal teams to set feature access rules based on compliance requirements and let users customize their platform experience within those boundaries.

Our services are some of the highest-traffic systems at the company, sitting in the hot path of nearly every user action across billions of accounts and millions of requests per second. As international regulations evolve and new features are built, our systems are how Roblox enforces, manages, and gives visibility into consistent behavior across dozens of features.

You Will:

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency services that shape what every Roblox user can see and do. The pod owns the full stack end-to-end, from gRPC services to caching, data pipelines, and client integrations.
  • Help set the technical direction for how feature access and user settings work across Roblox, evolving our systems as the platform and the regulatory landscape grow.
  • Partner directly with feature teams across Roblox to onboard them onto our platforms and turn evolving regulatory requirements into consistent product behavior. Past examples of this team’s contributions include:
    • Policy Deployment: Access rules used to ship as dynamic configuration, with no visibility into what was running in production and no way to revert without a code change. The team replaced that with a purpose-built deployment system with a custom UI, partial rollouts, shadow traffic, and one-click rollback. Policy deployment went from a source of anxiety to a routine, low-risk operation for the dozens of feature teams that depend on it daily.
    • Age-Checked Comms: In late 2025, Roblox introduced platform-wide Age Checks for all Communication features, including restrictions that only allow users to communicate with others in similar age ranges. Our access platform was the backbone of this rollout, giving every feature one centralized place to answer: Is this user Age Checked? Are they eligible to Age Check? Can these two users communicate?
  • Own the reliability, performance, and observability of systems that nearly every feature at Roblox depends on.
  • Mentor other engineers and add to the team’s culture of knowledge sharing, project retros, and bottoms-up technical decision-making.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or distributed systems at scale.
  • Strong fundamentals in service design, caching, data modeling, and performance. You know how to build systems that stay fast and correct under millions of requests per second.
  • A track record of leading projects from design through launch, including projects that span multiple teams or customers.
  • Bonus: Experience with authorization or access control systems, policy engines, configuration or feature-flag platforms, or regulatory compliance (e.g., age assurance, privacy, parental controls).
  • Educational Background: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

You Are:

  • Someone Who Thrives in Ambiguity: You take full ownership of problems that don’t come with a clear spec. When requirements are shifting or incomplete, you define the problem, make the call, and drive it to an outcome.
  • Innovative: You spot friction in existing processes, look for simple abstractions that remove a whole class of work, and turn your ideas into prototypes that shape where the team goes next.
  • Reliability-Focused: You understand what it means to own hot-path infrastructure. You make changes safe through rollouts, validation, and fast rollback.
  • Collaborative: You enjoy working across teams and product areas, and you’re comfortable translating ambiguous policy or regulatory requirements into concrete technical designs.
  • Mission Oriented: You care about keeping Roblox safe and compliant for users of all ages around the world.

Roblox is seeking a Principal Endpoint Platform Engineer to serve as the technical architect of our global endpoint ecosystem. Reporting to the Client Services Manager, you will define the long-term strategy for how our fleet scales, secures, and evolves. This role goes beyond day-to-day management — you will establish architectural standards, drive automation-first platform design, and ensure thousands of builders have secure, reliable tools to do their best work. From strengthening our security posture in a complex hybrid environment to mentoring senior engineers, you will shape the technical foundation that powers innovation at Roblox.

You Will:

  • Standardize the global security and management strategy for our entire fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS devices to ensure peak performance and ironclad compliance.
  • Evolve of our deployment pipeline, driving the automated rollout of patches, OS upgrades, and complex certificate lifecycles for all endpoints.
  • Lead the hardening of our endpoint security posture, partnering with InfoSec to architect automated remediation workflows and deploying advanced observability tools like CrowdStrike, and Kolide.
  • Design and scale internally owned systems within our hybrid environment.
  • Lead complex platform initiatives from architecture through global deployment and operational maturity.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Corporate Engineering, Security, Engineering, and People Ops to align technical roadmaps with broader company goals.
  • Navigate and resolve high-level ambiguity, transforming vague technical requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point, diagnosing deep-level architectural failures in hardware, software, and enterprise networking.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, providing senior-level response for critical system availability and high-priority security incidents.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, systems architecture, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Proven experience securing and managing global fleets of 5,000+ devices.
  • Deep expertise with endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro, Workspace ONE, Google Endpoint Management, Fleet, or Microsoft Intune.
  • Strong programming ability in Python, Bash, Go, or Ruby with a focus on automation and systems integration.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps-based configuration management.
  • Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management and Zero Trust architecture across Okta, Google Workspace, and Entra ID.
  • Strong understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and enterprise networking security.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large technical initiatives and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

You Are:

  • A security-focused architect passionate about solving complex endpoint challenges at scale.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguity, with the ability to provide technical clarity and direction in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Heavily metrics-driven and customer-centric, using data to validate the effectiveness of security controls and improve the Builder experience.
  • A collaborative engineer who builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and mentors junior & senior team members.

We're building the future of entertainment, and our Support Operations team plays a crucial role in ensuring a positive experience for our growing community. Support Operations is chartered with enabling Roblox’s customer service operations teams, through change management, subject matter expertise and by transforming the customer experience through strategy and execution. Product Support Managers power that mission, owning the end to end service delivery experience for the product and feature teams they support. We're looking for an experienced Manager to lead a team of Senior Product Support Manager to join our Support Operations team, focused on delivering exceptional agent and user experiences across all channels of support.

You will report to the Director of Support Operations and work across teams at Roblox to make a step-change in the support experience. You will lead a team of subject matter experts focused on specific Roblox’s product strategies, enabling them to create and innovate high-quality support experiences through chatbot and agent support channels. This role is highly cross-functional, bridging the gap between operations and product. 

Through data-driven insights, you will drive programs around weekly business reviews, voice of the customer to ensure we are continuously making recommendations for process improvements, product enhancements, agent tooling and automation that enable a more frictionless, consistent customer experience. You will partner with product leaders, influencing their roadmaps by providing insights gained from our global customer interactions. You will also work with Engineering to ensure that identified gaps are addressed and resolved in a timely manner. Lastly, as you create recommendations, you will operationalize these recommendations through strong program management in partnership with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.

You Will

  • Lead and develop a team of Product Support Managers. Mentor, coach, and grow your team. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and user focus.
  • Drive outcomes through metrics. Own top-line metrics such as Contact Rate, Average Handle Time, Time to Resolution and Recontact Rate. Use data to prioritize investments and hold your team and partners accountable.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Translate customer interaction insights into recommendations that shape the product roadmap, and partner with Engineering to get gaps resolved quickly.
  • Deliver multi-quarter programs. Scope and run large, cross-functional initiatives in technology, training, knowledge, and workflow solutions with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.
  • Partner with our India Operations team. Building swimlanes of the supporting work needed to enable the success of our Product Support Managers, including Escalations, knowledge base documentation and agent feedback loops.
  • Partner with BPO and workforce teams. Make sure agent needs are met, quality is consistent, and changes land smoothly across the agent population.
  • Ensure launch readiness. Own Product Support launch management and go-to-market documentation so CS Operations teams are ready for every release.
  • Build the knowledge foundation. Set standards for knowledge, macros, and process documentation for internal and external audiences.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience in operations management or product support, with a focus on creator and user experiences
  • 2+ years of experience managing and developing people
  • Experience developing processes that improve operational efficiency at scale
  • Strong data skills, with experience using metrics to lead decision-making
  • Strong program management skills and experience leading projects at scale
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, specifically Product, Engineering, international and BPO workforces
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience

You Are

  • Versatile: Comfortable across technologies and approaches, and creative and strategic with hard problems.
  • Analytical: Energized by large, ambiguous problems, and disciplined about measuring both problems and solutions.
  • User-oriented: You start with the needs of the user, whether a Roblox player, creator, agent, or internal engineer.
  • Team-oriented: You lift up your team and peers and leave the organization stronger.

title: Principal Product Manager, Content Platform
descriptionHtml:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Content Platform is the home of all content on Roblox - every mesh, image, sound, animation, script, and place that our creators build lives here. It ingests, stores, processes, and serves every asset on the platform, handling billions of requests a day from Studio, game servers, and the Roblox client. It decides who can use what, transcodes content into the right format and fidelity for every device and network, and delivers it to millions of players around the world. As one of the most foundational systems at Roblox, it is the backbone that every experience, every creator workflow, and every player session depends on - reliably, securely, and at scale.

The way content gets made is changing fast. AI and agents are about to multiply the volume of content created on Roblox by orders of magnitude, and creators expect to draft, iterate, version, and collaborate on their work the way modern software teams do. As the Product Leader for the team, you will define and lead the roadmap for how content is created, stored, understood, governed, and served on Roblox. Your work will shape the core infrastructure, APIs, and creator workflows that power every experience, and make the platform ready for the wave of AI creation. This is a rare opportunity to rebuild the content backbone of a platform used by tens of millions of people every day.

You will:

  • Own the vision and roadmap for the Content Platform, spanning ingest, storage, processing and transcoding, permissions, and delivery of every asset on Roblox.
  • Scale a mission-critical service that stores and serves all content on Roblox reliably and performantly, across billions of daily requests and a globally distributed infrastructure.
  • Make the platform ready for AI creation: scale the content backbone for orders of magnitude more content created by agents as well as people, and build the structured metadata and content understanding that agentic workflows, search, and safety depend on.
  • Support core developer workflows for creators, including drafts, versioning, branching and rollback, packages and dependencies, import and export from external tools, and open APIs that work as well for an automated pipeline as for a creator in Studio.
  • Evolve our permissions and licensing model so creators and IP holders can share, license, and protect their content with confidence, across users, groups, experiences, and AI agents.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engine, Studio, Creator Store, Trust & Safety, infrastructure, and AI teams to build systems that are reliable, extensible, and impactful at global scale.
  • Translate platform-wide goals into concrete platform capabilities and traceable metrics like reliability, latency, cost to serve, creator iteration speed, and adoption.

You are:

  • Experienced, with 8+ years of product management experience, ideally in large-scale systems, storage, content delivery, or developer platforms; familiarity with media pipelines, CDNs, or asset management systems is a plus.
  • Formal degree in a technical field such as: Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar experience.
  • Deeply technical, with a strong understanding of distributed systems, storage, APIs, and data modeling; capable of working closely with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.
  • A builder of developer products, with great taste in APIs and creator workflows and a deep understanding of how creators build, iterate, and ship.
  • AI-fluent, with a point of view on how agents and generative models will change the way content is created, managed, and consumed.
  • Metrics- and impact-driven, you can translate platform changes into measurable outcomes like reliability, latency, cost, and creator productivity.
  • Highly collaborative, with a track record of leading through influence across product, engineering, design, and data teams.
  • Self-directed, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and driven by curiosity, creativity, and a desire to scale systems that touch millions.
